title: Serving a Restraining Order
summary: Service of a TRO or final restraining order.

steps.text: Confirm the order and its conditions in the DV registry
Serve in person; give the respondent a copy
Explain the terms: no contact, locations, and consequences of violation
Seize weapons, firearms, FPIC and permits as the order directs
Arrange supervised retrieval of belongings if the order allows
Complete the return of service and enter it in the registry
Notify the victim that the order was served

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
